patch.value: GH-678: linked-test sandbox must preserve freshly installed project extensions across child processes

GitHub issue https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/678 reports that a freshly installed project extension disappears between sandboxed child processes. Preserve isolated extension discovery state without exposing the real tracker.

patch.value: A project extension installed inside a sandboxed linked-test run stays discoverable across the child processes of that run; Isolation is preserved: the sandbox never discovers or mutates the real repository tracker or global extension store; Regression coverage installs an extension inside the sandbox and asserts both discovery in a subsequent child process and non-leakage to the real workspace
